title: marketplace-collab-microtasks-log
content:
Morning sprint-style scratchpad for StellarHub marketplace integration (personal log). Quick, messy — meant for immediate follow-ups and microtasks.

Context: StellarHub is aiming to launch a connector to Redwood Hosted API for model inference and pay-per-call via our marketplace. Pilot customer: LexiAnalytics. Tight timeline: sandbox certs by next Wed.

Top priorities (today):
- [ ] Finalize OAuth redirect example for StellarHub dev portal (sample: /oauth/callback) — set cookie domain guidance. Estimate: 30m.
- [ ] Confirm webhook signing header name and HMAC secret rotation cadence with infra (blocking: SSO cert mismatch reported by partner). Pinged Ethan.
- [ ] Drop sample JSON payloads into GitHub PR draft (PR #58) — include both sync and async flows.
- [ ] Create small test prompt set for LexiAnalytics to validate response shape (embeds + generation).

Meeting notes (standup w/ StellarHub 10:30):
- Rep: Maya (StellarHub) — integration engineer; said they saw 403 when exchanging auth code.
- Action: check redirect URI registered in Dev Console vs registered on partner side.
- They are using a self-signed cert in sandbox; will swap for partner-signed cert tomorrow.
- They want an example billing mapping: calls -> products -> invoice line items. Need to provide 2 example SKUs.

Blockers / Risks:
- Legal: Mutual NDA still in review (legal pinged, expected EOD Tue). Cannot share production keys until done.
- Networking: Partner sandbox IP ranges not whitelisted; SRE to add once partner shares ranges (Sofia owning).
- Rate limits: Partner expects burst > 200 rps for initial test — Dedicated capacity discussion required if sustained. Flag for AE + Solutions.

Microtasks (personal):
- Quick debug steps for 403:
  1) Reproduce with CURL using their auth_code (ask for a small repro token).
  2) Inspect redirect_uri param vs console.
  3) Check server_time skew (they use GMT+3).
- Copy-paste TODO snippets to PR description for SDK examples.
- Draft 2-line status update for partner Slack channel: tell them we can do cert swap tomorrow and SRE will pre-authorize sandbox IPs once provided.

Acceptance Criteria for initial sandbox test:
- OAuth exchange succeeds without 4xx in 5 consecutive attempts from partner test rig.
- Webhook delivery success rate >= 95% for 100 test events.
- Example invoice shows mapping: 1) inference-call-per-1k-tokens, 2) embedding-call-per-1k-units.

Notes to self / reminders:
- Remember to include caching guidance for embeddings to reduce calls (link to docs page).
- Add a short blurb about model fallback strategy if hosted model OOMs — mention dedicated fallback policy.
- Follow-up with Legal if NDA not signed by Tue morning; escalate to manager if not by Tue EOD.

Quick links I referenced:
- Confluence onboarding page (linked above) — use checklist section B.
- GitHub PR #58: add sample responses and a small test harness script (python).
- Jira: MKTP-1123 is parent ticket for StellarHub onboarding. Child tickets: MKTP-1124 (OAuth), MKTP-1125 (webhooks), MKTP-1126 (billing mapping).

Estimated timeline (rough):
- Tue: cert swapped, legal NDA signed (if lucky), webhook secret rotation settled.
- Wed: run sandbox smoke tests, capture logs, send results to partner.
- Thu: open follow-up for Dedicated capacity discussion if partner needs sustained >200 rps.

End-of-day quick checklist (for tonight):
- [ ] Push minimal example to PR (30m)
- [ ] Slack update to @stella-integrations channel (5m)
- [ ] Email Legal with NDA deadline reminder (2m)

Random thoughts (brain dump):
- Could offer them an integration token with limited scope for faster testing (short TTL) — reduces legal friction.
- If they insist on self-signed certs, propose using our tunnel proxy for sandbox to avoid cert issues.

---
If I don't finish everything, move unfinished low-priority tasks to tomorrow morning and call it out in PM notes.

(End of scratchpad)
